about.en: Whuffie (WHUF) is the native token of Ethos Network, an onchain reputation protocol on Base where participants vouch for one another by staking the token, write reviews and attestations, and can be slashed for misplaced trust. Ethos' whitepaper describes every economic mechanism — vouching, fees, markets, bonds and rewards — as running through WHUF, with supply fixed at 10,000,000, no minting function and all protocol fees burned. The token is a single Base ERC-20, 0xeeee77bC7e82c0d4166d52F58239D4c5Bf41eeee (18 decimals).
